transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net TV and entertainment technical support. My name is Scott. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Scott. I'm calling about our TV package. Yesterday afternoon I upgraded our subscription to include the S-Net Ultra Sports and TNT Sports package so we could watch live football today. But right now when I tune to channels 401 and 402, the screen just displays a blue banner saying 'Channel Not Authorized - Subscription Required'!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly look into that television entitlement authorization for you. Before we query the conditional access system, may I please verify the full billing address and your security question answer?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 47 Birchwood Avenue, Newcastle upon Tyne, NE3 5DL. And the security question answer is my first car, Ford Fiesta.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that verifies the television subscriber records. What is the TV viewing card number?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The viewing card number is 0481 9920 184. Scott, I have eight friends from my local pub arriving at my house in exactly forty-five minutes to watch the Manchester derby cup final! I bought sixty pounds worth of food and drinks, and everyone is coming here specifically because I promised them I had upgraded to the sports package! If these channels don't work by kickoff, I will look like an absolute fool and ruin everyone's entire Saturday afternoon! I am in absolute agony with stress right now!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand the urgent stress of hosting eight friends for the derby cup final kickoff in forty-five minutes, and having the sports channels show an unauthorized error when everyone is on their way is deeply frustrating, so let us prioritize pushing an over-the-air card entitlement refresh right away.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Scott, that is an enormous relief to hear. Please send whatever signal is needed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am opening the NDS VideoGuard conditional access server console to verify tier entitlements for smartcard 0481 9920 184.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What does the conditional access server show for the sports tier?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The conditional access database confirms the order for Ultra Sports Tier Pack was provisioned yesterday, but the Over-The-Air Entitlement Management Message was cached in queue due to TV box standby mode.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My TV box was in standby overnight! Does that prevent the channels from activating?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If the TV box is in deep sleep standby, the satellite tuner demodulator cannot receive the broadcast transponder EMM cryptographic tier keys.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So if the box had stayed switched on, it would have received the signal automatically?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Continuous broadcast EMM bursts cycle across satellite transponder transport streams every thirty minutes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can we force the broadcast satellite signal to hit the box right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can transmit a High-Priority Forced Hit from our headend satellite uplink facility.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why didn't the upgrade email tell me to leave the TV box on overnight?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If you had actually bothered to read the confirmation email instead of complaining, you would know smartcard authorization takes up to four hours.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is an utterly rude and offensive attitude! I asked a reasonable question as a paying customer! I do not expect to be spoken to like a child by technical support!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Tune your TV box to Channel 401, S-Net Sports 1 HD.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am on channel 401 right now. It still shows the blue subscription banner.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have transmitted the Tier 400 Entitlement Key Refresh pulse across transponder twenty-four on Astra 28.2 East.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wait! The screen just blinked! The blue banner disappeared and live high-definition football coverage of the pre-match buildup just popped onto the screen with crystal clear audio!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The smartcard CAM processor has successfully decrypted the transport stream payload.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Now let me check channel 402, TNT Sports 1 HD.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Channel 402 carries the shared VideoGuard tier authorization token.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Switching to 402... TNT Sports 1 HD is playing perfectly in full 1080p surround sound!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously that confirms the conditional access smartcard has cached the active decryption keys for the complete sporting calendar.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You have saved the entire day! My friends will be knocking on the door in twenty minutes and the match is ready to watch!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us check your Ultra HD 4K sports option on channel 404 to ensure 4K HDR broadcast throughput is enabled.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Tuning to channel 404... S-Net Sports Ultra HDR loaded in breathtaking 4K resolution! The grass looks like you could touch it!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your TV box HDMI handshake supports HDCP 2.2 and BT.2020 wide colour gamut.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The picture quality is unbelievable.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us check the satellite dish LNB signal metrics under System Settings to ensure severe rain fade will not disrupt the match.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Navigating to System Settings, Signal Diagnostics... Transponder 24 signal strength shows eighty-two percent and signal quality shows ninety percent.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Ninety percent signal quality provides a high carrier-to-noise ratio margin against heavy storm clouds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is great reassurance in case it rains this afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you also access the S-Net TV Go mobile application on your tablet so you can view match stats in another room?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I have an iPad in the kitchen. Does our sports subscription include tablet streaming?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The Ultra Sports package includes concurrent streaming on up to two registered mobile devices simultaneously.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Testing S-Net TV Go on the iPad... logged in with my account... S-Net Sports 1 live stream loaded immediately! That is brilliant for the barbecue area!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The mobile stream adapts dynamically up to 1080p sixty frames per second.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let us also check the DVR hard disk recording schedule so I can record the post-match interviews.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Press the TV Guide button, select the post-match analysis slot at five PM, and press the Record button on the remote control.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Pressing Guide... selecting Post-Match Analysis... Record icon appeared with red dot. Scheduled recording confirmed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us check your TV box parental control PIN settings to make sure adult-rated sporting events do not require manual PIN entry after watershed.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Under Parental Settings, PIN Prompt is toggled to OFF for sports events, so the programmes start without interruption.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The disk management subsystem has allocated fifty gigabytes of reserved recording space for the series link.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is plenty of capacity for the whole season.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also check your TV remote control pairing to make sure volume and power toggle the television soundbar.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Volume up and down controls the Sonos soundbar directly through HDMI ARC.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The audio stream is encoding in Dolby Digital Plus 5.1 surround sound.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The commentary and stadium atmosphere sound phenomenal.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to reconfirm, the smartcard carrying the active sports tier is 0481 9920 184.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, 0481 9920 184. That is completely correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will remain the dedicated owner for this entertainment ticket and verify that the entitlement refresh logs permanent authorization.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you for getting the channels activated in time for the game.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else regarding your sports package or TV channels that I can assist you with today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that has sorted everything perfectly. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You may receive a short customer satisfaction survey by SMS after this call; we would appreciate any feedback on our service today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will fill out the survey. Have a good afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Have a wonderful day and enjoy the match. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, goodbye.
